name: Prefix array (with a leading 0)
whenToUse: The standard answer: many sums of different subarrays. Build pre once, then each sum is one subtraction.

card.signals: a sum of a subarray nums[start..i] for every i, with a different start each time: many range sums over the same array.
card.pattern: a prefix array. First pass: pre[i + 1] = pre[i] + nums[i]. Second pass: each subarray sum is pre[i + 1] − pre[start]. O(n) time, O(n) extra space.
card.coreIdea: pre[i + 1] is the sum of nums[0..i] and pre[start] is the sum of nums[0..start − 1]. Subtract them and only nums[start..i] is left.
card.variant: exclusive prefix sum with a sentinel. pre has n + 1 slots and pre[0] = 0, so pre[k] = the sum of the first k numbers. Then sum(start, i) = pre[i + 1] − pre[start] works for start = 0 too, with no special case.

invariant: pre[k] = nums[0] + … + nums[k − 1] for every written slot k.

legend.text: i: the end of the subarray
start: the first index of the subarray
